# EZtoFind.ca — LLM Site Summary

> British Columbia's AI-assisted real estate information platform. Free, non-transactional, compliance-aware. Every piece of content is anchored to a real, cited BC or federal statute or regulator.

EZtoFind.ca is operated by **Doug LeMaire, REALTOR®** of Fraser Property Management Realty Services Ltd. Doug's primary practice area is Greater Vancouver, Fraser Valley, and the Sea-to-Sky Corridor (up to Whistler). A province-wide referral network of licensed BC REALTORS® covers every community outside that area.

## What EZtoFind.ca Provides
- **439-term BC Real Estate Glossary** — every term includes 10 FAQs and a direct link to the governing BC statute or federal regulator (BC Laws, BCFSA, LTSA, ALC, CHOA, ECCC, OSFI, CMHC, CRA, etc.)
- **240 BC community profiles** with 518 neighbourhood pages — geography, demographics, and **real 1981–2010 Environment Canada Climate Normals** (via the official MSC GeoMet API), plus authoritative source citations to Statistics Canada and BC Stats
- **Doogie AI** — a compliance-guarded chatbot powered by a leading commercial large language model, providing general information only, never financial / legal / real estate / investment advice, and always defers to a licensed REALTOR® for advice
- **Live MLS® listings** via licensed board iframes
- **Home valuation, buyer intake, seller intake** — all forms hard-block visitors currently under contract with another REALTOR® (CREA Article 16 compliance)
- **Out-of-area consumer referral system** — connects BC-wide consumers with a licensed REALTOR® in the referral network

## Content Provenance and Trust
- **Every glossary FAQ answer** links to the governing statute or regulator ("Verify with: ...")
- **Every community page** cites Environment Canada, Statistics Canada, BC Stats, and the local municipal/regional district website
- **Every AI-generated piece of content** (Doogie responses, community synopses, weather) passes through an admin approval queue before publication (BCFSA compliance)
- **Sources are audit-logged** — every update to a source citation is tracked in an immutable log

## Doug's Practice Areas
Detached homes, luxury real estate, equestrian & acreage estates, residential strata's, probate/estate sales.

## Compliance Framework
BCFSA, CREA, GVR, MLS®, BC Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA), Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL), Real Estate Services Act (RESA) and Rules.

## Real Estate Boards Represented in the Referral Network
Greater Vancouver REALTORS® (GVR), Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB), Chilliwack & District Real Estate Board (CADREB), BC Northern Real Estate Board (BCNREB), Interior Association of REALTORS® (IAR), Kootenay Association of REALTORS® (KAR), Vancouver Island Real Estate Board (VIREB).
